limitations: 172 MGRS entries describe source raster footprints intersecting broad geographic search windows, not an island count and not a provincial land mask.
Footprints include sea and potentially land outside the intended Hainan administrative scope. Neither sovereignty nor a maritime/administrative boundary is inferred.
The source index reuses the 530 selected scenes from the exhausted 2025 catalogue search; it does not fetch or claim pixel inspection of all catalogue matches.

SCL samples use 25 regularly spaced points per selected scene from its coarsest existing categorical overview. Any counts or fractions describe only these sample points. Spatially tiny islands can be missed entirely.
Accepted SCL classes 2,4,5,6 in a sample do not validate corresponding RGB values, guarantee absence of haze/cloud, or implement the preview processing's dilation and strict clear-fraction threshold.
No-source SCL samples mean class 0 at sampled locations only; quality-rejected samples and network failures are separate. No whole-grid absence is inferred.
11 audited previews comprise one broad main-island/nearshore view plus 10 named rectangular display windows. Pixel counts include water, may overlap, and cannot be summed into island/provincial area.
A complete, authoritative island inventory and reusable island/administrative polygons are not present. There is no province-wide completeness percentage or province-area statistic in this audit.

Projected raster corners are exact transformations of catalogue affine grid geometry. EPSG:4326 GeoJSON edges use <=1000 m densification in the native projection; this polyline is a display approximation of transformed raster edges, not a land outline.
